generic_sop: I am Daniyal Majeed, a first-semester B.Sc. Chemical Engineering student at UET Peshawar, Pakistan. I scored 1029/1200 in Matric and 429/600 in HSSC-I, and I have built a foundation in chemical process basics, oil and gas fundamentals, MATLAB, AutoCAD, graphic design and HTML/CSS. My goal is to become a process engineer who designs cleaner, more efficient and renewable energy systems for regions like mine that face energy shortages. International exposure, research training and access to modern laboratories would let me turn classroom theory into practical solutions. I am eager to learn, collaborate across cultures, and bring what I learn back to Pakistan's energy sector.
